quarterly_data.quarter: Synopsys press release: Synopsys Powers Autonomous Engineering with a Broad (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Synopsys announced Synopsys AgentEngineer solutions, domain-specific long-horizon agents that reason, plan and execute complete engineering workflows across verification, system validation, implementation, analog, manufacturing and simulation and analysis, built on the new Synopsys Autopilot Platform (orchestration, skills, memory, telemetry, governance; open to Synopsys, partner and third-party models and infrastructure). More than 50 engagements are underway, with general availability planned for the end of 2026. Results the company cites from market leaders include up to 50x faster verification closure, 20% higher coverage, a 30% productivity boost and 2x better token efficiency. Named users: Fujitsu reported a 10-30% productivity boost in RTL code generation with Verification AgentEngineer; AheadComputing used the Implementation AgentEngineer from RTL handoff through signoff; Intel is working with Verification AgentEngineer for debug. NVIDIA said Synopsys is building its long-running agents with NVIDIA accelerated computing and the NVIDIA Agent Toolkit (Nemotron models, OpenShell secure runtime). Chief Product Management Officer Ravi Subramanian: the portfolio enables customers to shift 'from AI-assisted design to autonomous engineering'.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 50 engagements; general availability planned for the end of 2026; Fujitsu 10-30% productivity boost in RTL code generation
